title: 搜索真实会话标题：结果收窄且能打开
description: 取两个都在首屏的会话：输入其中一个的标题片段后，它仍在结果里，另一个必须消失。只断言「目标出现」是不够的——目标本来就在列表上；必须证明过滤真的发生了。
preconditions: 应用已启动；首屏至少有两个短标题会话。
expectations: 搜索框能输入并实时过滤
匹配的会话仍在结果里
不匹配的会话从结果里消失
Escape 关闭搜索后列表恢复

db.sql: SELECT title FROM (SELECT title FROM threads WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status != 'deleted' AND length(title) BETWEEN 6 AND 16 ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, updated_at) DESC LIMIT 8) LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0

SELECT substr(title, 1, 6) AS q FROM (SELECT title FROM threads WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status != 'deleted' AND length(title) BETWEEN 6 AND 16 ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, updated_at) DESC LIMIT 8) LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0

SELECT title FROM (SELECT title FROM threads WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status != 'deleted' AND length(title) BETWEEN 6 AND 16 ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, updated_at) DESC LIMIT 8) LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

assert.message: 过滤前另一个会话确实在首屏
匹配的会话保留在结果里
不匹配的会话被过滤掉
关闭搜索后列表恢复（另一个会话回来）
